sourceLabel: MANUAL VERIFIED REFERENCE - maintained by hand by the owner from sources the owner has checked
tradabilityStatement: A manual local reference is NOT live entitlement, is NOT automatically refreshed, and does NOT prove current tradability. It only records that the owner checked an entry against a named source on a stated date.
howToAddAnEntry: Append an object to "contracts" with: entryId (unique), underlying (NIFTY|BANKNIFTY|SENSEX), strike (integer), optionType (CE|PE), expiryDate (YYYY-MM-DD), lotSize (integer), source (what you checked), verifiedAsOf (YYYY-MM-DD you checked it), notes (evidence reference, e.g. a circular number or file name). tickSize is optional; omit it unless the source states it. Never copy values you have not checked.
